caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large two-part topic title uses a broad lavender rough-lettered capsule for the operative phrase, followed by a black instruction strap.
visual_anatomy.layout: Four equal vertical columns create a content-role taxonomy; each column contains a purpose statement, a shared central journey node, idea chips, one format row, and example hook cards.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and instruction strap → four role headers left to right → purpose row → central connecting journey → idea chips → format and example rows.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans title, rough display tag, bold role headers, compact sans content chips, and smaller multi-line examples that preserve a tabular reading rhythm.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, and blue identify the four roles from header to tags and examples; the central journey uses matching colour blocks with dark arrows.
visual_anatomy.surface: White field, thin lavender board outline, rigid column/row rules, rounded chips and cards, modest shadows, and a high-contrast black instruction bar.
visual_anatomy.modules: Four equivalent role columns crossed with purpose, idea, format, and hook rows, plus one centre-row chain linking their stated outcomes.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high: the matrix works because repeated row labels and a single horizontal outcome chain make the four dense columns comparable.

motion.observed_state_change: The same four-column matrix persists through the samples. A dark highlight travels through the instruction strap and a soft colour emphasis passes across the central horizontal outcome chain before a near-complete wipe/reset; no category content changes.
motion.motion_job: Direct attention along the system-level link between otherwise separate taxonomy columns, while keeping the full reference board available.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand how distinct roles contribute to one joined system rather than treating a category taxonomy as four disconnected lists.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Role taxonomy with a cross-column outcome chain.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use stable parallel columns for distinct roles, then place one concise cross-column chain in a shared row to make their system relationship explicit.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the categories have both genuinely distinct responsibilities and a meaningful joined flow; otherwise use a simpler comparison with no implied sequence.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s four-category content taxonomy, instruction prompt, purpose statements, chips, hook examples, outcome chain, colour assignment, rough title tag, or highlight/wipe loop.

claim_boundary.note: The visual contains business, platform, and content-outcome assertions. The supplied corpus does not independently verify those claims or the asserted caption association.
